svg.text: a full-block modem between two joins both
right-click each modem: it turns red
• Chests and furnaces need a full-block wired modem touching them; barrels and drawers take a small one directly.
• Put modems on the drawers themselves, not a drawer controller (it would count everything twice).
• No wireless modem needed: everything is on the cable (one lets it report to the status server).
